reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216967) reported that senior diplomat Sergey Ryabkov stated Russia clearly laid out its position at the Abu Dhabi talks and expects a response.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216973) reported that Sergey Ryabkov addressed Europe's dejection, the Putin-Witkoff meeting, and Abu Dhabi outcomes.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-and-ukraine-trade-strikes-as-peace-talks-end-with-little-progress/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Russia and Ukraine were targeted by mutual attacks hours after concluding trilateral peace talks mediated by the United States.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/detalji-pregovora-u-abu-dhabiju-rusija-za-rat-u-ukrajini-okrivila-bidena-tvrde-da-im-nije-odgovorio-na-pismo/261112055) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff requested a new security agreement proposal with Europe from Russia.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1087349/rusija-krivi-bajdena-za-rat-tvrde-da-nije-odgovorio-na-putinovo-pismo) reported that Russia blamed Biden for the war during trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi, claiming he did not respond to Putin's letter.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/witkoff-and-kushner-arrive-in-moscow-seeking-putins-blessing-to-bring-europe-into-ukraine-) reported that Steve Witkoff is visiting Russia for the tenth time since Donald Trump's return to the White House, accompanied by Jared Kushner.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/us-envoys-arrive-in-moscow-for-russia-ukraine-talks-with-putin?traffic_source=rss) reported that the meeting with Kushner and Witkoff follows two days of trilateral talks in the UAE that yielded no breakthrough.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/us-envoys-arrive-in-moscow-for-latest-round-of-talks-with-putin-a94236) reported that this week's talks were the first direct talks between Russia and Ukraine mediated by the U.S. in nine months.
[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/russia-ukraine-trade-strikes-as-us-envoys-land-in-moscow) reported that Russia and Ukraine traded overnight strikes as the U.S. envoys arrived.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-prisoner-swap-trump-envoy-kushner-witkoff-b3083499.html) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to their biggest prisoner swap yet at the Abu Dhabi peace summit.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-envoys-jared-kushner-and-steve-witkoff-arrive-in-russia-for-latest-round-of-ukraine-peace-talks-with-vladimir-putin-101794470586213.html) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow for Ukraine peace talks with Putin, and will subsequently fly to Dublin to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/news-1RZjMaLSVR6/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Russia and Ukraine struck a major prisoner swap deal in Abu Dhabi.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/news-1RZga98dQA0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported a source in the Russian negotiating group stated that trilateral talks involving Russia, the United States and Ukraine ended in Abu Dhabi.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177706) reported that US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived at Vnukovo airport in Moscow to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/kremlin-aide-calls-abu-dhabi-ukraine-talks-substantive-3725471) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov described two days of US-mediated trilateral Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi as substantive and quite useful.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraine-reports-major-progress-in-russia-peace-talks) reported that Ukraine's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov stated negotiations with Russia yielded significant progress on security and economic prosperity.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/russia-and-ukraine-say-some-progress-made-talks-us-cites-lack-trust) reported that Russian and Ukrainian negotiators reported some progress in two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/russia-refused-to-discuss-ceasefire-or-territorial-issues-on-second-day-of-abu-dhabi-peace-talks-shifting-focus-to-european-security-architecture-rbc-ukraine-reports) reported that the Russian delegation refused to discuss territorial issues, a ceasefire, energy, or Black Sea security on the second day of talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/witkoff-and-kushner-arrive-in-moscow-for-talks-with-putin) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, arrived in Moscow on the morning of November 12.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/11/abu-dhabi-talks-end-with-prisoner-exchange-but-no-peace-breakthrough-a94227) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to carry out a major exchange of prisoners in the coming days despite persistent differences in negotiation positions.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/emisarios-trump-negocian-putin-moscu-otra-noche-misiles-drones_202611126af574ed9a31a65adcd94edd.html) reported that Moscow launched multiple ballistic missiles and 123 long-range drones against Kyiv and other areas of Ukraine.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/enviados-de-eeuu-viajan-a-moscu-para-reunirse-con-putin-tras-conversaciones-en-abu-dabi_0_GrVpHKcKgE.html) reported that United States representatives met with Russian leadership in Moscow following negotiations in Abu Dhabi regarding a prisoner of war exchange.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/they-re-bringing-something-kushner-and-witkoff-to-meet-putin-in-moscow-day-after-abu-dhabi-peace-talks) reported that U.S. presidential special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow following the Abu Dhabi peace talks.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/11/russia-ukraine-peace-talks-conclude-in-abu-dhabi-with-prisoner-exchange-agreement-but-no-breakthrough-on-territory) reported that the trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States in Abu Dhabi ended with a prisoner exchange agreement but no breakthrough on territory.
